question: What kind of spender am I?
title: Your spender type

cells.title: Your money shape, as the Learn tab shows it
cells.code:
p = kori.profile()
arch = p["archetype"]
traits = p.get("traits") or []
strong, weak = p.get("strongest") or {}, p.get("weakest") or {}
emit("name", arch["name"], "text", "Your spender type")
emit("strongest", strong.get("label") or "-", "text", "Your strongest side")
emit("weakest", (weak.get("label") or "-").lower(), "text", "Most room to grow")
emit("traits_found", len(traits), "count", "Habits that stand out")
table("shape", [{"label": s["label"], "score": s["score"]} for s in p.get("shape") or []], "Your money shape, each side scored from nothing to full")
rows = [{"name": t["name"], "evidence": t["evidence"], "pctl": "more than " + num(t["percentile"], 0) + "% of people"} for t in traits]
table("traits", rows or [{"name": arch["name"], "evidence": arch["tagline"], "pctl": ""}], "What shows in your transactions")

if strong and weak and p.get("shape"):
    say(f"You are **{arch['name']}**. {arch['tagline']}")
